tenderSchedule.title: Establishment of Integrated Public Distribution Monitoring System by Supplying, Installation, Commissioning, Establishment, Operation, Maintenance and Management of State-Level Command and Control Centre at the Office of the Commissioner, Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Bengaluru, Karnataka by integrating Vehicle Location Tracking System Devices (GPS) and Warehouse Surveillance Systems (CCTV) across the State.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Food Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Commissioner, Food, Civil Supplies Consumer Affairs Department, No. 8, Cunningham Road, Bangalore - 560052

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per Tender Document all conditions to be fulfilled

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have experience in atleast deploying two Software projects for any Government Department,Government Institution,Semi Government Organization, in any five preceding financial years,(Refer tender document)

The Bidder shall have experience in successfully executing One or more project(s) involving the supply, installation, configuration, integration, testing, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and management of a complete Command and Control Centre (CCC) infrastructure, including integration of GPS-Based Vehicle Location Tracking System of atleast minimum 10000 vehicles or minimum 150 CCTV Surveillance Systems, for any Government Department, Government Institution, Semi-Government Organization, in any five preceding financial years
The Bidder should have an experience of hosting atleast 1 software projects developed by them at KSDC (Karnataka State Data Center) server

Bidders shall provide detailed PPT Presentation understanding the Scope of the Project, Technical Approach, Methodology, Implementation & Work Plan. In addition, the PPT presentation shall also include detailed presentation of the Bidders experience in executing similar projects in other Government Departments

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: As per tender document all Documents and annexures
